minutes.summary: The committee approved earlier minutes, then went through the non-controversial and controversial proposed charter changes section by section. Nothing was finally decided; items were set for follow-up with the town manager, town counsel and the moderator.

Delegation language was removed in sections 3-5, 3-9 and 3-13, and "ratify" is to be changed to "affirm" throughout.
The committee discussed replacing newspaper publication of the budget summary with the website, while mailing the summary with the warrant; no resolution.
There was general agreement to leave the town accountant appointed by the Select Board.
The next meeting is August 22nd, with the review schedule to be revised.
